name: Urban Voyeur
source:
You play as a young successful doctor who has just moved to New York to work in a private clinic. What no one knows is that you've this obsession to watch people, and you use your powerful telescope at night to scan the neighborhood.

The game starts after your first week in New York with you exploring a brand new neighborhood. Soon you'll be sucked into different situations that involve your co-workers, patients and neighbors...

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/cesargames]Patreon[/url]]
